name: ErrorState
description: Explains what failed, what's safe and how to recover, in place of content that couldn't load: an icon tile or a large status number, a title, a description, a reference code people can quote and recovery actions. Pairs with EmptyState; it isn't ValidationSummary, which lists form errors.

react.name: ErrorState
differences: ErrorDisplay stays as a deprecated alias (title, message, icon, onRetry, retryLabel).

vue.name: ErrorState
differences: ErrorDisplay stays as a deprecated alias (title, message, icon, retry event, retryLabel).

props.name: variant
props.description: What failed: a request, the connection, a missing page or missing access. Picks the tile's tint and default icon (server-crash, wifi-off, lock); not-found shows the numeral 404 instead. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: size
props.description: md for a page or card; sm for a panel. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: align
props.description: Centered, or aligned to the start in the reading direction. Emitted as data-align.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name from the registry. Defaults to the variant's. A slot or node overrides it; set explicitly, it shows beside a numeral too.

props.name: numeral
props.description: A large status number, such as 404 or 503, in place of the default icon. not-found defaults to 404.

props.name: title
props.description: What failed, as a heading. Don't blame the person.

props.name: description
props.description: What's safe and what to do. The default slot (children) fills it too.

props.name: code
props.description: A reference people can quote to support, such as Error 503 · req_8f2c91.

props.name: actions
props.description: Recovery buttons, such as Try again.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level, 2 to 6. Use 1 for a full-page error.

props.name: focusTitle
props.description: Moves focus to the title when it renders (tabindex=-1), for a full-page error that replaces the page.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…', code: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The error state (role=alert), so an error that replaces content is announced.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: The icon tile, tinted by the variant, hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: description
parts.description: What's safe and what to do.

parts.name: code
parts.description: The reference for support, in the mono font.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Rich description. The default slot fills it too.

keyboard.action: Moves through the recovery actions; with focusTitle, focus starts on the title.

requirements: role=alert, so an error that replaces content is announced.
On a full-page error, focus moves to the title (focusTitle), which shows the focus ring.
The title is a heading at the right level; the icon is decorative (aria-hidden).
Say what failed and what's safe, include a reference code people can quote, and don't blame the person.

props.title: Couldn't load transactions
props.description: The payments service didn't respond. Your data is safe; try again in a moment.
